comparison.objective: Return a screwdriver to a fitted case and latch the lid, versus adjust and commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Shape-matched placement and clasp closure differ from using the screwdriver/hex key as an active rotary tool, collar adjustment, counterholding, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seated tool, closed caught clasp, arm return, and stillness; no dynamic response or post-lock drift validation.
comparison.reason: Tool handling and latching are incidental shared primitives only.
